source: macOS say system voices, generated locally and not redistributed

cases.text: 你好，这是本地语音助手。
cases.agentReply: 你好，很高兴和你进行本地语音对话。

cases.text: 请介绍一下实时语音处理。
cases.agentReply: 实时语音处理需要兼顾延迟、准确率和稳定性。

cases.text: 今天的天气适合出去散步。
cases.agentReply: 如果天气舒适，适当散步有助于放松身心。

cases.text: 请记住百分之二十五这个数字。
cases.agentReply: 好的，我记住了百分之二十五。

cases.text: 我们正在测试语音识别准确率。
cases.agentReply: 测试会记录识别结果和完整的延迟分布。

cases.text: 请在回答时保持自然和清晰。
cases.agentReply: 好的，我会使用自然清晰的语气回答。

cases.text: Hello this is a local voice assistant
cases.agentReply: Hello, the local voice pipeline is ready.

cases.text: Please measure the speech recognition latency
cases.agentReply: The benchmark records every latency boundary.

cases.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
cases.agentReply: That sentence contains every important sound.

cases.text: We are testing an interruptible conversation
cases.agentReply: You can interrupt the answer at any time.

cases.text: Local processing keeps the audio on this computer
cases.agentReply: Your audio remains inside the local pipeline.

cases.text: Please answer with a warm and natural voice
cases.agentReply: I will answer with a warm and natural voice.
